oracle: Hand-specified contract violations and source repairs; no labels inferred from checker output.

cases.rationale: The input stream reaches fallthrough without close.
cases.repair: Close the locally acquired stream in finally.

cases.rationale: read uses the same stream after close.
cases.repair: Read before closing and return the saved data.

cases.rationale: An Owned return hands off an alias of a closed resource.
cases.repair: Return the open allocation and transfer cleanup to the caller.

cases.rationale: The explicitly declared validation decision is discarded.
cases.repair: Return the decision to the caller.

cases.rationale: Overwriting the cursor loses the first allocation without cleanup.
cases.repair: Finish the first cursor before replacement.

cases.rationale: execute is called on the finished cursor.
cases.repair: Execute before finishing.

cases.rationale: Finally closes a cursor after evaluating its Owned return.
cases.repair: Return the open cursor and transfer its cleanup duty.

cases.rationale: The MustUse query text is discarded.
cases.repair: Return the generated query.

cases.rationale: The handler releases a borrowed caller-owned session.
cases.repair: Use the session and leave release to its owner.

cases.rationale: A request-local session is abandoned open.
cases.repair: Release in finally.

cases.rationale: The response queries a released session.
cases.repair: Save the response before release.

cases.rationale: The declared authorization result is ignored.
cases.repair: Return the decision for caller handling.

cases.rationale: An early return leaves the local archive open.
cases.repair: Wrap the return in try/finally cleanup.

cases.rationale: Closing an alias also closes the original archive.
cases.repair: Inspect before closing either alias.

cases.rationale: Verbose SharedBorrow metadata forbids caller cleanup.
cases.repair: Inspect the archive and preserve caller ownership.

cases.rationale: A callable alias still carries the result-use contract.
cases.repair: Return the manifest through the alias.

projects.title: SDK result handling

cases.rationale: A resolved instance method's required result is dropped.
cases.repair: Return the fetched value.

cases.rationale: The known staticmethod wrapper preserves must-use.
cases.repair: Return the constructed request.

cases.rationale: The known classmethod wrapper preserves must-use.
cases.repair: Return the constructed cursor.

cases.rationale: The imported callable alias preserves must-use.
cases.repair: Return its version value.

projects.title: Async worker before its first suspension

cases.rationale: The coroutine reaches its exit with an open link and no suspension.
cases.repair: Close the link before returning.

cases.rationale: Acknowledgment uses a synchronously closed link before suspension.
cases.repair: Acknowledge before close.

cases.rationale: An async function returns a closed link through Owned before suspension.
cases.repair: Return an open link under the owning contract.

cases.rationale: A synchronous must-use decoder result is ignored inside async code.
cases.repair: Return the payload.

cases.rationale: The re-exported borrowed token belongs to its caller.
cases.repair: Preserve its lifetime while inspecting it.

cases.rationale: A token acquired through a named re-export is lost open.
cases.repair: Release the local token.

cases.rationale: A Borrowed token is falsely returned under an Owned contract.
cases.repair: Return derived data while leaving the caller-owned token with its owner.

cases.rationale: Named re-export keeps the required-result contract.
cases.repair: Return the plugin configuration.

cases.rationale: A helper imported through a named re-export closes the caller's token before use.
cases.repair: Inspect the token before passing it to the imported cleanup helper.

cases.rationale: The explicit exception abandons an open writer.
cases.repair: Finish the writer in finally during the raise.

cases.rationale: Writing uses the finalized writer.
cases.repair: Write before finishing.

cases.rationale: An owning factory hands off a finalized writer.
cases.repair: Transfer the open writer to its caller.

cases.rationale: The required checksum result is discarded.
cases.repair: Return the checksum.

projects.title: Dynamic plugin resolution and source non-execution
Repeated close without an idempotency model

oracle_revisions: Draft 1 incorrectly assigned TP1003 to repeat-close and expected imported non-resource class methods and bare constructor statements to be supported. The draft reports and sources are retained separately. Revision 2 uses documented Owned-return violations, keeps descriptor controls local, and tests repeat-close as an explicit boundary.

Revision 3 adds an imported lifecycle helper with an independent use-after-close oracle after the previous candidate reported its effect as unknown. Resolution follows named re-exports while preserving unknown behavior for imports whose provider participates in a cycle.
